name: release-dropper
description: Renderer and shared code for Release Dropper (the Tauri app in ../tauri loads the compiled renderer)

scripts.build:renderer: tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && mkdir -p dist/renderer/renderer/fonts && cp src/renderer/index.html src/renderer/style.css dist/renderer/renderer/ && cp src/renderer/fonts/*.ttf dist/renderer/renderer/fonts/
